facts.fact: The dry season has come and the Monkey Pass has reopened by this chapter, weeks after the charter.
facts.why: needed because the pepper-cart escort contract requires a reopened pass

facts.fact: The queen read the open truce aloud on the Kodiyur harbour steps; Usha told Neela of it. An open truce lets Thurai ships return under a truce cloth to talk.
facts.why: needed because the beat says the fleet sailed under an open truce read on the harbour steps

facts.fact: The Company's first earnings are a crown payment for a month of holding the pass; the Company voted to buy a twelve-foot fishing boat from a boatwright at Pazhayangadi, named Kirri.
facts.why: needed because the beat names the boat and its first-earnings purchase

facts.fact: Devan removed the tin shutter from the hall door lamp on the first evening; it burns sesame oil day and night, unshuttered.
facts.why: needed to land the reinterpretation callback to the lookout lamp opened a thumb's width

facts.fact: The pepper factors of the lower village offer pay by the cart to escort forty carts over the pass; the Company votes forty-one for, nine against, rest holding, with Neela's clause that only paired members go.
facts.why: needed because the beat sets the first contract by vote with paired members only

facts.fact: The Thurai envoy is unnamed: a tall man in pale robe with a white truce cloth. With him is a servant carrying a flat box and a lean long-jawed odiyan wearing a ring on his left thumb, the man Neela saw sleeping by the siege tower in ch 6.
facts.why: needed because the beat's hinge requires an envoy and the scarred rogue
